question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

claims.text: Total client assets - Morgan Stanley: The Wealth Management financial supplement (published 2026-10-14) shows total client assets of $8,433 billion at September 30, 2026, of which advisor-led client assets were $6,631 billion. The same table shows $8,084 billion total and $6,273 billion advisor-led at June 30, 2026.

Total client assets - Schwab: The 3Q26 earnings release (published 2026-10-15) shows total client assets of 13,333.2 ($ billions) at the end of the quarter, split into Investor Services 7,487.3 and Advisor Services 5,845.9. The prior-quarter column (June 30, 2026) shows 13,084.9 total. On the 3Q26 call (October 2026), the CEO said the adviser business serves more than 16,000 firms representing $5.8 trillion in assets.

Total client assets - Edward Jones: The 2Q26 10-Q (published 2026-08-07) reports client assets under care of $2,647 billion at period end (June 26, 2026), including advisory programs of $1,198 billion.

Total client assets - Raymond James: The 3Q FY26 earnings release (published 2026-07-22) reports client assets under administration of $1,922.4 billion at June 30, 2026. Of that, Private Client Group assets under administration were $1,856.5 billion and PCG assets in fee-based accounts were $1,153.8 billion.

Financial advisor count - Edward Jones: The 2Q26 10-Q (published 2026-08-07) states the Partnership ended the second quarter of 2026 with 20,514 financial advisors. The segment table splits the period-end count into 19,647 and 867 across its two geographic columns (the firm operates in the U.S. and Canada).

Financial advisor count - Raymond James: The FY2025 10-K (period ending 2025-09-30) reports 8,943 total advisors, made up of 3,878 employees and 5,065 independent contractors. Advisors in the RIA and Custody Services (RCS) division are not included in the count.

Definitions - Morgan Stanley: Wealth Management defines client assets as covering advisor-led brokerage, investment advisory, custody and related services, self-directed brokerage and advisory services, financial and wealth planning, and workplace services including stock plan administration and retirement plan services. Advisor-led client assets are those in accounts that have a Wealth Management representative assigned. Self-directed client assets are active accounts that are not advisor-led, with active meaning at least $25 in assets. The 2Q26 10-Q (published 2026-08-04) says stock plan unvested assets are not included in client assets. The 3Q26 supplement shows advisor-led client assets of $6,631 billion and self-directed client assets of $1,802 billion within total client assets of $8,433 billion.

Definitions - Schwab: Schwab's 2025 10-K describes two segments. Investor Services covers retail brokerage, advisory and banking and trust services to individuals, plus retirement plan and business services. Advisor Services provides custodial, trading, banking and trust, and support services to independent RIAs, independent retirement advisors and recordkeepers. Schwab defines assets receiving ongoing advisory services as client assets custodied at the company under the guidance of an independent advisor or enrolled in one of Schwab's managed investing solutions. Schwab Advisor Network advisors are described as independent and not employees or agents of Charles Schwab & Co. Total client assets of 13,333.2 ($ billions) include 5,845.9 in Advisor Services.

Definitions - Edward Jones: The 2Q26 10-Q describes 'client assets under care' for the Partnership, which operates in the U.S. and Canada, and the advisor count covers both countries. The 2025 10-K risk factors note that many of the Partnership's financial advisors are employees. Client assets under care of $2,647 billion are reported on a consolidated basis for the Partnership.

Definitions - Merrill: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-25) describes Merrill Wealth Management's advisory business as a network of financial advisors focused on clients with over $250,000 in total investable assets. No Merrill-specific definition of an advisor count or of client assets is in the evidence; see the adjacent GWIM items.

Definitions - Raymond James: The FY2025 10-K (period ending 2025-09-30) says its AUA includes assets of firms affiliated through RCS ($217.3 billion at September 30, 2025), while financial advisors associated with RCS firms are not in the financial advisor counts. Its advisor count combines employee advisors and independent contractor advisors. The 10-K says independent contractor advisors are responsible for their direct costs and receive a higher payout percentage than employee advisors. The firm reports client assets under administration of $1,922.4 billion, of which PCG AUA is $1,856.5 billion. The 3Q FY26 release says Clark Capital ($47 billion of total client assets at acquisition) was integrated into the Asset Management segment.

adjacent.text: Bank of America's Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM) segment, which contains Merrill Wealth Management and Bank of America Private Bank, reported total client balances (EOP) of 5,056.8 ($ billions) at 9/30/2026. The segment's key-indicator table lists a Merrill Wealth Management business line with client balances of $4,240,601 (millions) and Private Bank balances of $816,186 (millions) at September 30, 2026.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's. The Merrill Wealth Management line is a business line within the segment's supplement, not standalone Merrill results, and no advisor count is attached to it.

adjacent.text: Merrill advisor counts exist only at segment or wider scope. The BAC 4Q23 supplement (published 2024-01-12) shows 18,916 total wealth advisors at period end, including advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking. The November 2025 investor-day deck shows '>15K Wealth Advisors' for Merrill | Private Bank, with $4.6T client balances.
adjacent.differs_because: These counts cover GWIM (and Consumer Banking in the 2023 figure), not Merrill alone. The two figures also use different scopes and dates, so they are not comparable with each other.

adjacent.text: Morgan Stanley's 4Q20 supplement (published 2021-01-20) reported 15,950 Wealth Management representatives at December 31, 2020.
adjacent.differs_because: It is a 2020 figure, not a current count, and the evidence has no current Morgan Stanley advisor count.

adjacent.text: Schwab describes serving more than 16,000 firms representing $5.8 trillion in assets (3Q26 call) and shows 16K independent RIAs in its May 2026 investor-day deck.
adjacent.differs_because: These count independent advisory firms that custody with Schwab, not Schwab financial consultants or wealth advisors, and no Schwab advisor headcount is given.

adjacent.text: On the 2Q26 call (July 2026), Bank of America's CFO credited 'strong adviser productivity' for GWIM results, but gave no per-advisor figure.
adjacent.differs_because: It is a qualitative management statement about the GWIM segment, not a disclosed client assets per advisor or revenue per advisor figure.

adjacent.text: Bank of America's 2025 10-K defines GWIM client balances as assets under management, brokerage and other assets, deposits, and loans and leases, less managed deposits in assets under management. The 4Q23 supplement footnote says its advisor count covers advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
adjacent.differs_because: These are GWIM segment definitions (Merrill plus the Private Bank), not Merrill-only definitions, though they show GWIM's client balances include deposits and loans.

gaps.what: Merrill does not report standalone results.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America 10-K or 10-Q GWIM segment disclosure, or a Merrill-specific investor presentation

gaps.what: Morgan Stanley - financial advisor count: not found in the evidence provided (the only count is from 2020).
gaps.suggested_source: Morgan Stanley 10-K Item 1 or Wealth Management financial supplement, current advisor count

gaps.suggested_source: Schwab 10-K Item 1 or investor-day materials giving financial consultant and wealth advisor headcount

gaps.what: Merrill does not report standalone results.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America investor materials giving a Merrill-only financial advisor count
